requirements.requirement: DCP-0 remains a non-production successor and does not alter D-018 or RC3 classifications.
Web owns Better Auth human identity/control-plane concerns and Data Platform receives only machine-verifier projection.
The projected contract specifies UUID mapping, event versioning, ordering, idempotency, replay, revocation, rotation, and fail-closed behavior.
Tower database planning is disabled and secret-reference-only, with no apply or project manifest mutation.
API-key provider selection remains conditional until project binding, portable verification, audit, rotation/revocation, runtime, and security fit are proven.
